Xn-U.description: gNB CU-UP <-> gNB CU-UP, GTP-U data forwarding

SBI.description: core NF <-> core NF, HTTP/2 (Nnrf, Nausf, Nudm, Npcf, Nsmf, Namf)

notes: One gNB per site (CU-CP + CU-UP + DU); gNBs connected by Xn (Xn-C control, Xn-U forwarding).
Uu latency = wait for the next slot boundary + one slot.
User plane: packets travel in per-epoch batches; the trace has one record per epoch per UE per hop (bytes, packets); each packet keeps its own timestamps and delay breakdown.
Air: per-UE capacity per epoch from the radio twin's scheduler (SINR -> CQI -> bits on its PRBs), served FIFO slot by slot; + 1 slot on air + HARQ retransmissions (BLER from the config).
Every UE with a DRB loads its cell for the whole epoch (full-load interference): conservative at low traffic.
NAS (N1) is carried hop by hop: RRC (Uu/fronthaul) -> F1AP (F1-C) -> NGAP (N2); see 'nas'.
T3 coordinates PRB muting jointly across the gNBs (near-RT RIC/E2 not modelled).
Traffic: Poisson packets per UE at traffic.rate_mbps (open loop, no TCP).
Handovers: A3 (offset, time-to-trigger in walk steps) evaluated on the twin's RSRP.
Messages to a switched-off element are logged with delivered=false.
Latencies and processing times are configurable assumptions, not measurements.

upf_selection.rule: DNN + S-NSSAI + capacity, then TAI locality, then lowest load
